lessons: Review finding at clutch/providers.py:272: a skipped preflight leaves the fresh ProviderLLM's adapters with cli_version None, because ProviderLLM.preflight (providers.py:962) is the only place that sets it. Evidence (providers.py:512) then records None for every ticket after the first.

When the probe succeeds, store each provider's adapter.cli_version on ProviderSession along with the remembered providers/routing key. On a skip in runner.prepare_pipeline and __main__._preflighted_llm, copy the stored versions onto the new ProviderLLM's adapters without running --version.

A failed or changed-config preflight must still clear or replace the stored versions together with the key, so stale versions never outlive their probe. Keep the existing concurrency lock and phase-event skip unchanged.

Add a case to tests/unit/test_preflight_once_per_session.py: after two prepare_pipeline calls on one session with an equal snapshot, the second call's adapters carry the same cli_version as the first, and --version ran only once.

Rerun both ## Verification commands: ./dev.py test on the three named unit files, then ./dev.py test. Edit only files in the scope fence, and leave tests/integration/test_daemon_composition.py untouched.
